answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the juniper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A garden of per-task receipts records who did what, and the wander of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
